f3_program: collection("nancy_and_rose.beads", "bead", "nancy_and_rose", source("Nancy has 40 metal beads and 20 more pearl beads. Rose has 20 crystal beads and twice as many stone beads as crystal beads."))

member("nancy_and_rose.beads", "nancy_and_rose.beads.rose.crystal", source("Rose has 20 crystal beads"))
member("nancy_and_rose.beads", "nancy_and_rose.beads.rose.stone", source("Rose has 20 crystal beads and twice as many stone beads as crystal beads"))

offset(at("nancy_and_rose.beads.nancy.pearl.count", "current"), at("nancy_and_rose.beads.nancy.metal.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("Nancy has 40 metal beads and 20 more pearl beads"))
observe(at("nancy_and_rose.beads.rose.crystal.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("Rose has 20 crystal beads"))
multiple(at("nancy_and_rose.beads.rose.stone.count", "current"), at("nancy_and_rose.beads.rose.crystal.count", "current"), 2, source("twice as many stone beads as crystal beads"))

partition("nancy_and_rose.beads", at("nancy_and_rose.beads.count", "current"), source("Nancy has 40 metal beads and 20 more pearl beads. Rose has 20 crystal beads and twice as many stone beads as crystal beads."))
observe(at("bracelet.beads.count", "per_bracelet"), 8, "count", source("there are eight beads in each bracelet"))

rate_relation(at("nancy_and_rose.beads.count", "current"), at("bracelet.beads.count", "per_bracelet"), at("nancy_and_rose.bracelets.count", "current"), source("there are eight beads in each bracelet"))
query("value", at("nancy_and_rose.bracelets.count", "current"))
assumptions: The four stated bead categories are the available bead collection, and “can make” refers to bracelets formed from that collection at eight beads per bracelet.
